description: This file defines the base class for datetime widget plugins in Drupal, handling form element creation, value massaging, and default value creation for date/time fields.

classes.name: DateTimeWidgetBase
classes.description: Base class for datetime widget plugins, providing form element creation, value processing, and default value generation.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Creates the form element for the datetime widget, setting default values and timezone based on field settings.

methods.name: massageFormValues
methods.description: Converts form input values back to storage format, adjusting for timezone and format.

methods.name: createDefaultValue
methods.description: Creates a default date object for the widget, applying the correct timezone and resetting date for date-only fields.
